acquisition_targets.policy_summary: Close HOLES first (esp. fingerprints absent from the expansion), then raise UNDER-floor fingerprints, while CAPPING over-supplied ones and deduplicating them toward distinct reactions. Pause broad out_of_scope draining (kinase/phosphatase/glycoside lanes are already saturated) until the positive holes are closed -- the binding constraint is diverse positive supply, not raw count.
